label: Alakazam
summary: Single-prize hand-size grinder: Abra -> Kadabra -> Alakazam (140 HP, 1 prize) whose Powerful Hand (cost P, base 0) places 2 damage counters per card in hand on the ACTIVE only, no floor. A heavy draw engine (Kadabra/Alakazam Psychic Draw on evolve, repeatable Dudunsparce Run Away Draw, Enriching draw-4) inflates the hand to fire; every body is 1 prize. Beat it by winning the prize race on even trades and REMOVING the body, never out-grinding the hand: hand-disruption timed to the swing turn, wall the Active + promote fresh after a KO, and hit through Darkness weakness (never Fighting, the line resists -30). Do not target Dudunsparce (self-shuffles).

threats.why: The sole win condition. Powerful Hand (cost P, base 0) = 20 x cards-in-hand on the Active with NO cap — OHKOs essentially any single Active given a big enough hand. Active-only/single-target (no bench spread), 140 HP, 1 prize, Darkness-weak.

The deck's ONLY reach to our bench (Powerful Hand is Active-only). Gusts a fragile setup piece into the Active to pick it off, or drags a benched wincon out to KO around our wall. Don't bench a snipeable key piece assuming it's safe.

Special-energy tax, x4. Engine diverges from real-TCG: discards a Special Energy from ANY of our Pokemon (not Active-only). Attack off Basic energy where possible to make all four dead cards; don't pre-load special energy on a single body. (Energy denial vs THEM is near-useless — Alakazam attacks off one Basic.)

targets.why: Sole attacker and payoff; the Psychic line does NOT self-shuffle, so KOing the body is real prize progress AND tempo denial (slow to re-assemble). Darkness x2 (140 -> 70-base OHKO), or any 140 hit. Remove it — do not out-grind its hand size.

50 HP, 1 prize, Darkness-weak, base of the ONLY win line. KO pre-evolution to deny an Alakazam and tax their search (they re-find via Buddy Poffin / Poke Pad / Dawn / Hilda). BATTLE CAGE CAVEAT: it blocks damage counters on the bench, so a benched-Abra snipe is blanked while the Cage is up — gust it Active (Active hits land normally) or overwrite the Cage with our own stadium. Also resists Fighting (-30). NOTE: do NOT spend removal on Dudunsparce (Run Away Draw self-shuffles it back — refunded).

80 HP, 1 prize, Darkness-weak middle of the line and a draw node (Psychic Draw +2 on evolve). KOing it (or the Abra under it) before Alakazam lands sets the engine back a full evolution step. Same Battle Cage caveat — route the hit through the Active, not the bench. Resists Fighting (-30).
